css: .at07-page{font-family:'Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#111;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}.at07-h1{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px 0;color:#111}.at07-sub{font-size:11px;color:#555;margin:0 0 12px 0}.at07-meta{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0 0 14px 0}.at07-meta td{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #d6d6d6}.at07-meta .label{background:#f4f4f4;color:#444;font-weight:600;width:24%}.at07-section{margin:18px 0 8px 0;padding:6px 0 4px 0;border-bottom:2px solid #111;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#111;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}.at07-denom{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:6px 0 4px 0}.at07-denom th,.at07-denom td{border:1px solid #d6d6d6;padding:5px 8px;text-align:right;font-size:10px}.at07-denom th{background:#f4f4f4;color:#444;font-weight:600;text-align:center}.at07-denom td.left{text-align:left}.at07-denom tfoot td{font-weight:700;background:#fafafa}.at07-narrative{margin:6px 0 12px 0;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #d6d6d6;background:#fbfbfb;min-height:36px;white-space:pre-wrap}.at07-narrative .lbl{display:block;font-weight:600;color:#444;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.5px}.at07-signoff{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:10px 0 0 0}.at07-signoff td{vertical-align:top;width:50%;border:1px solid #d6d6d6;padding:10px 12px}.at07-signoff .role{font-weight:700;font-size:11px;color:#111;margin-bottom:6px}.at07-signoff .name{font-size:10px;color:#444}.at07-signoff .ts{font-size:9px;color:#888;margin-top:2px}.at07-signoff .notes{margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px dashed #ccc;font-size:10px;white-space:pre-wrap}.at07-signoff .placeholder{color:#bbb;font-style:italic}.at07-foot{margin-top:18px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #d6d6d6;font-size:9px;color:#888;text-align:center}.at07-pos{color:#0a7}.at07-neg{color:#b91c1c}
